name: FORTBLOX ⭐
desc:
🎮 Fortblox: The Ultimate Battle Royale Experience!

Drop in. Gear up. Build fast. Survive to the end.

Welcome to Fortblox, the most intense and action-packed battle royale game on Roblox! Fortblox throws you into a fast-paced island showdown where only one player (or squad) can claim victory.

🏝️ Land Anywhere – Parachute into a massive open map filled with unique locations, hidden loot, and secrets to discover.
🔫 Loot & Eliminate – Grab powerful weapons, shields, and gear to outplay your opponents and be the last one standing.
🧱 Build to Survive – Use your materials to build walls, ramps, and forts on the fly — outbuild and outsmart your enemies!
👥 Solo, Duo, or Squads – Team up with friends or go solo in different battle modes.
